summary: Hand-wrote the reader-facing console pages for the fair-expectimax family: the family page approaches/fair-expectimax/README.mdx, and replacements for the ten generated draft pages (chance-strata, selective-depth, root-risk, cem, fair-policy, rollout-improvement, full-action-terms, phase-fair-combination, transition-rewards, vertical-ladder), plus a summary line added to the existing reference page's frontmatter. Every page follows docs/agents/approach-page-template.md: plain-English opening, mechanism, numbered steps, then the retained record inside a collapsible block, with each figure quoted from docs/research/history.md, docs/research/experiment-index.md or docs/exploratory/ and carrying its status, evidence label and scoring mode. The chance-strata and vertical-ladder pages set the ledger rejections beside the exploratory audit/finding records that contest them; the vertical-ladder figure is a BoardCompare generated by the TypeScript engine. No research record, source file or protocol was modified.
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.
